description: Dedicated entries for nine major mercenary companies.

entries.title: The Iron Vanguard
entries.summary: Blackstone Keep's disciplined heavy mercenaries protect caravans, cities, nobles, and hunt giants and dragons.
body: The Vanguard operates with military precision from a fortified floating island. Steel-plated recruits bear a crossed sword and shield and commonly serve governments and powerful merchants.

entries.title: The Silver Fangs
entries.summary: Forest-hidden specialists handle bounty hunting, assassination, discreet protection, scouting, and ruins exploration.
body: Messaran operatives favor precision and survival skill over force. Silvered daggers, wolf-pelt cloaks, tracking expertise, and rumored beast-folk members define their reputation.

entries.title: The Emberhawks
entries.summary: Ember's Roost fields daring aerial mercenaries specializing in ship protection, anti-piracy, and airborne monsters.
body: The drifting skyship base follows trade routes. Modified airships, alchemical weapons, red uniforms, flaming-hawk insignia, and flare signals support fast aggressive operations.

entries.title: The Stone Shields
entries.summary: Granite Hearth's Dwarven defenders protect elites, mountain caravans, fortifications, and critical sites.
body: Rune-inscribed shields, heavy armor, defensive magic, engineering, and exceptional loyalty make the Stone Shields specialists in holding ground under severe pressure.

entries.title: The Gilded Gauntlet
entries.summary: Aetherspire's theatrical elite mercenaries pursue prestigious security, treasure, ruins, artifacts, and wealthy patrons.
body: Polished gilded armor, heralds, a crown-clutching gauntlet, and conspicuous showmanship support the company's pursuit of glory and lucrative contracts.

entries.title: The Black Scales
entries.summary: Jungle-based monster hunters pursue apex predators, magical beasts, criminals, and wilderness contracts.
body: Dragon-scale arms, trophies made from hunted creatures, and strong Lizardfolk and Dragon Kin membership reflect their ferocity and adaptation to untamed southern regions.

entries.title: The Wandering Blades
entries.summary: Nomadic, affordable, mixed-skill teams accept nearly any useful contract across settlements, caravans, ruins, wars, and disasters.
body: Without a fixed headquarters, the Wandering Blades maintain scattered outposts and self-sufficient teams. Common folk value their flexibility, accessibility, and reasonable prices.

entries.title: The Night Wardens
entries.summary: Obsidian Spire's secretive guards confront nocturnal creatures, undead, curses, and haunted ruins.
body: Dark lightweight armor, revealing lanterns, curse expertise, and a chained crescent emblem support their role as watchers against supernatural darkness.

entries.title: The Azure Striders
entries.summary: Skyreach Citadel's rapid-response company escorts vessels, answers emergencies, and delivers urgent messages and cargo.
body: Light sky-blue uniforms, enchanted boots, a winged-boot emblem, and proximity to major trade winds support the Striders' reputation for speed and reliability.
